entries.msgstr:
The view range will be increased by {colorTagOpen}%(visionBuff_1)s/%(visionBuff_2)s/%(visionBuff_3)s%%{colorTagClose} for {colorTagOpen}%(duration)s s{colorTagClose}.

The timer will reset when an enemy vehicle is destroyed upon your spotting.
Active Recon

For {colorTagOpen}%(duration)s s{colorTagClose}, your crew receives a {colorTagOpen}%(crewBuff_1)s/%(crewBuff_2)s/%(crewBuff_3)s%%{colorTagClose} bonus to efficiency for each vehicle on your team with a different role.

Your vehicle will always be included in the calculation of this bonus.
One for All

For {colorTagOpen}%(duration)s s{colorTagClose}, an area with a radius of {colorTagOpen}%(radius)s m{colorTagClose} is created around your vehicle that restores {colorTagOpen}%(heal_1)s/%(heal_2)s/%(heal_3)s{colorTagClose} hit points for your vehicle and allied vehicles.
Field Repairs
For {colorTagOpen}%(duration)s s{colorTagClose}, your crew and allied crews receive a {colorTagOpen}%(crewBuff_1)s/%(crewBuff_2)s/%(crewBuff_3)s%%{colorTagClose} bonus to efficiency.
Inspire

For {colorTagOpen}%(duration)s s{colorTagClose}, the gun reload time is reduced by {colorTagOpen}%(gunReloadTimeBuff_1)s/%(gunReloadTimeBuff_2)s/%(gunReloadTimeBuff_3)s%%{colorTagClose}. Also, gun dispersion after firing, during movement, and during hull and turret traverse is reduced by {colorTagOpen}%(shotDispersionFactorsBuff_1)s/%(shotDispersionFactorsBuff_2)s/%(shotDispersionFactorsBuff_3)s%%{colorTagClose}.

The timer will reset when you cause damage by ramming or shooting from a distance of under {colorTagOpen}%(damageDistance)s m{colorTagClose}.
Fury

For {colorTagOpen}%(duration)s s{colorTagClose}, aiming time and gun dispersion during movement, hull traverse, and turret traverse are reduced by {colorTagOpen}%(shotDispersionFactorsBuff_1)s/%(shotDispersionFactorsBuff_2)s/%(shotDispersionFactorsBuff_3)s%%{colorTagClose}.

While this Role Skill is active, the reload time between shots is reduced by {colorTagOpen}%(clipReloadTimeBoost_1)s/%(clipReloadTimeBoost_2)s/%(clipReloadTimeBoost_3)s s{colorTagClose}.
Focus on the Target

• For a magazine loading system:
The remaining magazine reload time is reduced by: {colorTagOpen}%(gunReloadTimeBuff_1)s/%(gunReloadTimeBuff_2)s/%(gunReloadTimeBuff_3)s%%{colorTagClose}

• For an autoreloading system:
All fired shells in the current cycle will be reloaded: {colorTagOpen}%(gunReloadTimeBuff_1)s/%(gunReloadTimeBuff_2)s/%(gunReloadTimeBuff_3)s%%{colorTagClose}

The skill can only be activated during the reloading process.

• For Thermal Overheat Control Autocannon:
Gun heat is reduced by {colorTagOpen}%(gunTemperatureBuff_1)s/%(gunTemperatureBuff_2)s/%(gunTemperatureBuff_3)s%%{colorTagClose} of its possible maximum.

The skill can only be activated if the gun is heated.
Sleight of Hand

Resets the number of enemy vehicles damaged by shots.

For {colorTagOpen}%(duration)s s{colorTagClose}, your vehicle will restore {colorTagOpen}%(heal_1)s/%(heal_2)s/%(heal_3)s{colorTagClose} hit points for each enemy vehicle damaged by a shot at the moment of activation.
Gun reload time is reduced by {colorTagOpen}%(gunReloadTimeBuff)s%%{colorTagClose} for each enemy vehicle damaged by a shot.
Bounty Hunter
Juggernaut

For {colorTagOpen}%(duration_1)s/%(duration_2)s/%(duration_3)s s{colorTagClose}, your vehicle's engine power will increase by {colorTagOpen}%(enginePowerBuff)s%%{colorTagClose}, its top forward speed will increase by {colorTagOpen}%(fwdSpeedBoost)s{colorTagClose} km/h, and its concealment value will increase by {colorTagOpen}%(invisibilityFactor)s%%{colorTagClose}.
Forced March

A recon aircraft will fly over the selected area within {colorTagOpen}%(delay)s s{colorTagClose}. Enemy vehicles detected within a radius of {colorTagOpen}%(radius_1)s/%(radius_2)s/%(radius_3)s m{colorTagClose} remain spotted for {colorTagOpen}%(duration_1)s/%(duration_2)s/%(duration_3)s s{colorTagClose}. A separate icon will be displayed for a player detected by this skill with a {colorTagOpen}%(lampDelay)s s{colorTagClose} delay.

This skill becomes available for use {colorTagOpen}%(startupDelay)s s{colorTagClose} after the battle starts.
Recon Flight

The selected area will be attacked by an artillery strike within {colorTagOpen}%(delay)s s{colorTagClose}.

The targets damaged within a radius of {colorTagOpen}%(radius_1)s/%(radius_2)s/%(radius_3)s m{colorTagClose} will receive {colorTagOpen}%(damage_1)s/%(damage_2)s/%(damage_3)s{colorTagClose} HP of damage and will be stunned for {colorTagOpen}%(stunDuration_1)s/%(stunDuration_2)s/%(stunDuration_3)s s{colorTagClose}.
Fire Cover

Acceleration

For {colorTagOpen}%(duration)s s{colorTagClose}, engine power increases by {colorTagOpen}%(enginePowerBuff)s%%{colorTagClose}, the top forward speed increases by {colorTagOpen}%(fwdSpeedBoost)s{colorTagClose} km/h, and the top reverse speed increases by {colorTagOpen}%(bkwSpeedBoost)s{colorTagClose} km/h.

Recovery

For {colorTagOpen}%(healDuration)s s{colorTagClose}, your vehicle restores {colorTagOpen}%(baseHeal)s{colorTagClose} hit points {colorTagOpen}+%(extraHealFactor_1)s/%(extraHealFactor_2)s/%(extraHealFactor_3)s%%{colorTagClose} of hit points lost while Acceleration is active.
Second Wind
At the beginning of a battle, the charge level of the Role Skill is{colorTagOpen} %(startLevel)s{colorTagClose}.

For {colorTagOpen}%(duration_1)s/%(duration_2)s/%(duration_3)s s{colorTagClose}, dispersion at 100 m is equal to {colorTagOpen}%(dispersionFactor)s m{colorTagClose}.

If your vehicle has not been spotted at the moment of the shot, the damage caused with your shell will increase by {colorTagOpen}%(damageFactors_1)s/%(damageFactors_2)s/%(damageFactors_3)s%%{colorTagClose}. 

The timer will be reset for damage caused by shooting from a distance of over {colorTagOpen}%(damageDistance)s m{colorTagClose}.
Bullseye

For {colorTagOpen}%(duration)s s{colorTagClose}, gun dispersion during movement, hull traverse, and turret traverse is reduced by {colorTagOpen}%(shotDispersionFactorsBuff_1)s/%(shotDispersionFactorsBuff_2)s/%(shotDispersionFactorsBuff_3)s%%{colorTagClose}.

While this skill is active, damage by shooting reduces gun reload time by {colorTagOpen}%(gunReloadBuffDamage_1)s/%(gunReloadBuffDamage_2)s/%(gunReloadBuffDamage_3)s%%{colorTagClose} of the percentage by which the enemy vehicle's hit points have decreased.

Destroying an enemy vehicle reduces gun reload time by {colorTagOpen}%(gunReloadBuffDestroy_1)s/%(gunReloadBuffDestroy_2)s/%(gunReloadBuffDestroy_3)s%%{colorTagClose}.
Clean Shot
